description.text: OVERVIEW We are currently seeking a Scientist Immunopeptidomics* to join our Target Research and Development team in Tuebingen, Germany. Your work will combine experimental immunopeptidomics, quantitative proteomics and data interpretation to characterize HLA-presented targets, advance our platform toward future clinical applications and contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. Working closely with laboratory scientists, our mass spectrometry team and colleagues in Data Intelligence, you will develop robust analytical methods and help connect experimental work with reproducible data analysis. This is an opportunity to contribute your scientific expertise and ideas, explore new technologies and shape streamlined, digitally connected workflows that translate research findings into meaningful applications. This position is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months. YOUR MISSION Your main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Characterize and quantify HLA-presented peptides using Immatics’ proprietary absolute quantitation technology to support therapeutic target validation and the evaluation of biomarkers for patient selection and disease monitoring. Develop, optimize and validate immunopeptidomics methodologies using protein biochemistry and mass spectrometry, with a focus on reproducibility, scalability and the analysis of clinically relevant samples. Coordinate and manage target characterization activities across departments, aligning experimental plans, timelines and interpretation of results with laboratory, mass spectrometry and Data Intelligence colleagues. Establish suitable controls and performance criteria for new workflows, critically evaluate experimental results and document methods and findings to support their transfer into standardized laboratory processes. Help develop streamlined, digitally connected workflows and evaluate AI-assisted approaches to data interpretation, documentation and process improvement in collaboration with laboratory and Data Intelligence colleagues. YOUR PROFILE You hold a PhD in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Medicine, Pharmacy or a related field, ideally complemented by postdoctoral or industry experience. You have expertise in proteomics and/or immunopeptidomics, including protein biochemistry and sample preparation for mass spectrometry. Experience in translational research, biomarker development, clinical assay validation, DIA-based workflows, clinical cohorts or multi-omics approaches is an advantage. You are passionate about combining experimental science with data-driven approaches and improving the efficiency and reproducibility of research workflows. Experience with laboratory automation, digital workflows, AI-supported tools, and regulated laboratory processes, including SOPs and method validation, is a plus. You are motivated to translate scientific discoveries into clinical applications, work independently and analytically, and communicate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Fluency in written and spoken English is required; additional German language skills are desired. WHY US? We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME. Driven by our mission to make an impact on the lives of patients with cancer, we are a committed and inspired team and cherish the collegial, highly motivated, and family-friendly atmosphere within Immatics. We offer an innovative and collaborative environment where employees are empowered to contribute to groundbreaking cancer therapies and further their professional growth. To support their well-being, we provide opportunities for continuous learning, a company-sponsored pension scheme, childcare support, and our flexible “Two Out of Three” benefits concept, which allows employees to receive subsidies for two of the following options: EGYM Wellpass, JobRad, and JobTicket. NOTICE *We value diversity and inclusion. Immatics N.V. and all Immatics subsidiaries are equal opportunity employers that evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other characteristics protected by law. ABOUT IMMATICS Immatics is committed to making a meaningful impact on the lives of patients with cancer. We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME, a target expressed in more than 50 cancers. Our cutting-edge science and robust clinical pipeline form the broadest PRAME franchise with the most PRAME indications and modalities, spanning TCR T-cell therapies and TCR bispecifics.

OVERVIEW We are currently seeking a Principal Manager Central Imaging* to strengthen our Clinical Sciences team in the clinical development of innovative cancer immunotherapeutic products. You will work in an interdisciplinary environment with internal colleagues and external imaging vendors and will contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. The position can be filled in Tübingen, Munich or remote within Germany and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months. YOUR MISSION You will independently manage central imaging activities for assigned global oncology trials and contribute scientific expertise to imaging endpoints and response assessments. Your main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Provide risk-based oversight of imaging vendors, monitoring image quality, query resolution, turnaround times, reader performance and adjudication metrics. Drive issue resolution and escalate risks impacting study milestones. Coordinate vendor and site readiness, including imaging systems, training, image submission processes, and review of imaging charters, manuals and project plans. Partner with Clinical Operations and vendors on site onboarding, imaging training and compliance with imaging procedures. Collaborate with Data Management and Biostatistics on imaging eCRFs, data specifications, reconciliation and transfers to ensure reliable endpoint data and timely analyses. Develop and implement central imaging strategies for assigned trials, aligning imaging endpoints, response criteria (e.g., RECIST 1.1, iRECIST) and operational requirements with study design. Provide imaging expertise for protocols, amendments, statistical analysis plans and regulatory documents, including radiation protection and patient-facing materials. Define imaging vendor requirements and support vendor qualification, selection and contracting in partnership with Vendor Management, Quality Assurance and Legal. Support imaging audits and inspections, maintain oversight of documentation and track corrective and preventive actions. Contribute to clinical study reports, regulatory submissions and publications, and develop imaging procedures, work instructions and training materials. YOUR PROFILE You hold an MSc, PharmD or preferably a PhD in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy or a related field and bring 4+ years of experience in clinical development, clinical trial management and central imaging in oncology. You have expertise in BICR processes, CT/MRI/PET imaging, RECIST 1.1 and iRECIST, as well as managing imaging vendors and operations in global clinical trials. Experience in late-stage oncology, immuno-oncology, T-cell therapies or T-cell-engaging bispecifics is highly desirable. You possess strong knowledge of ICH-GCP and clinical imaging requirements and can assess imaging data and processes, identify risks and implement effective solutions. Experience with regulatory submissions, audits and inspections is a plus. You are an independent, analytical and collaborative professional with excellent English communication skills (German is considered an advantage) who thrives in a dynamic environment. A structured, proactive mindset, strong ownership and a passion for improving outcomes for patients with cancer complete your profile. WHY US? title: Senior/ Principal Manager Medical & Scientific Writing*

description.text: OVERVIEW We are currently seeking a Senior or Principal Manager Medical & Scientific Writing* to join our Clinical Sciences team with a primary focus on Phase III clinical trials and Biologics License Application (BLA) submissions. You will work in Tübingen, Munich or remote within Germany in an interdisciplinary environment with colleagues from clinical and non-clinical teams and will contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. This position is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months. YOUR MISSION As a part of cross-functional teams, you will independently manage assigned medical writing activities mainly for late-stage clinical trials and associated regulatory submissions. Your main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Plan, author and coordinate clinical documents for BLA submissions ensuring a consistent presentation and interpretation of clinical data across documents. Prepare regulatory documents supporting Phase 3 as well as early clinical trials, clinical trial applications in Europe, and IND submissions in the USA, including clinical trial protocols and amendments, investigator’s brochures, and clinical sections of Investigational Medicinal Product Dossiers. Prepare briefing books for scientific advice meetings in Europe and the USA including meetings supporting late-stage development and BLA submission planning. Write medical and scientific sections, develop document strategies and coordinate cross-functional input, reviews and comment resolution. Manage document timelines, dependencies and deliverables to meet study and submission milestones. Provide medical writing oversight of external writers and vendors, including review of document plans and drafts, coordination of feedback, and monitoring of quality and timelines. Perform and coordinate quality control of medical and scientific documents, including consistency checks against source data and across the clinical dossier. Research scientific and clinical development topics using the scientific literature and integrate key findings into regulatory documents and summaries for internal use. YOUR PROFILE You hold a Master’s degree, preferably a PhD, in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, or a related field. You bring 4+ years of medical writing experience in the biopharmaceutical industry or a comparable environment, including substantial experience with Phase III clinical trials and BLA submissions. You have a strong understanding of regulatory requirements for clinical documents and submissions and are able to translate complex efficacy and safety data into clear, scientifically sound regulatory documents. Experience overseeing external medical writers or vendors is preferred. Expertise in immuno-oncology, particularly T-cell therapies or T-cell-engaging bispecifics, is highly desirable. You combine excellent English writing skills with strong analytical and organizational abilities and a high level of accuracy. You work independently, collaborate effectively across functions, manage complex reviews and timelines, and thrive in a dynamic, quality-driven environment. Experience using AI-assisted tools for medical writing and document quality control is an advantage.
